title: Shielded Representations: Protecting Sensitive Attributes Through Iterative Gradient-Based Projection

bias_targets.methodology: Intrinsic evaluation on GloVe embeddings using WEAT (Word Embeddings Association Test) and probe classifier leakage, as well as extrinsic evaluation on the Bias in Bios dataset by measuring True Positive Rate (TPR) Gap, probe leakage, and Minimum Description Length (MDL) compression for occupation prediction.

Extrinsic evaluation on the DIAL (Dialectal tweets) dataset by measuring True Positive Rate (TPR) Gap, probe leakage, and Minimum Description Length (MDL) compression for sentiment analysis across texts associated with African American English versus Standard American English.
